newsitem.title: USA: Quake reported off coast of Trinidad.
newsitem.headline: Quake reported off coast of Trinidad.

text.p: An earthquake with a preliminary reading of 6.5 on the open-ended Richter scale occurred on Tuesday morning off the coast of Trinidad and Tobago, the U.S. Geological Survey said.
"That's a good-sized earthquake. The potential for damage might exist," spokeswoman Rebecca Phipps told Reuters.

She said it "appeared to be an underwater quake," and its epicentre was 35 miles (55 km) northeast of the Trinidad capital Port-of-Spain. The quake occurred at 5:31 a.m. local time (5:31 EST/0931 GMT).
"There are no reports of damage or injuries, but it only happened a couple of hours ago," Phipps said.
